summary: Charlotte's Web Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the appointment of James Jeffery Raborn to its board of directors effective May 28, 2026, and the results of its annual general and special meeting. Raborn was designated by British American Tobacco (BAT) under an amended investor rights agreement. The meeting ratified the board size at six directors. The filing is a routine current report covering a board appointment and shareholder vote results; no special situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring is present. The registrant is the issuer filing a compliance update.
